decisive_spans.text: A punch biopsy showed no epidermal changes and revealed a dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis
a white-cell count of 13,000/mm3 with 89% neutrophils

response.rationale: D1 is strongly supported by the presence of a dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate in the dermis and neutrophilia, which are key features of neutrophilic urticaria. D6 is contradicted by the absence of epidermal changes, which are typically seen in erythema multiforme.
